initial_diagnostic: Original PCA tangent plane is self-referential for depth-stretched sheets; all 36 representation runs rejected zero. Retain complete initial results. No removal rate target.
change: Replace candidate-contaminated tangent qualification only when two endpoint-excluded outward source-pixel patches independently support a sharp first-depth discontinuity. Reject only interpolating faces, never vertices or supported layers.
formula: 1/Z=alpha*du+beta*dv+gamma; endpoint excluded from its 8-sample 3x3 outward half-patch; >=6 original Polyp valid samples, rank3; depth RMS and endpoint residual <=0.5/4=0.125 mm; bidirectional endpoint extrapolation error >0.5mm; length/(mean planar predicted edge lengths)>4; both patch incidences>=0.2. Same perspective8, jump0.5, source edge2px or CAD-material context, triangle quality/normal condition.
unknown_policy: Insufficient patch support, actual legitimate CAD occlusion or invalid native binding -> retain. Plane-proven step replaces contaminated triangle/PCA grazing flag only for the gap-crossing face.
evidence_dependencies: Both patches share HERO prediction and are not statistically independent; never report independent vote count. Separation reduces candidate-face self-explanation, not HERO systematic error.
scope: Same single-video 18 sources; both original archive and native grid; archive rejection requires mapped confirmed native edge and its own severe jump/shape/context. No per-group branches.
